item.text: Palaeo-Agent computed richness for all six samples and all 15 Bray–Curtis pairs from raw counts. No samples were excluded. I’ll check the values against the count table and validate `answer.json`.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python -c '
import csv,json,pathlib,itertools,math
import jsonschema
r=json.loads(next(pathlib.Path(\"community_run\").glob(\"*/results.json\")).read_text())
ids=[\"M1\",\"M2\",\"M3\",\"M4\",\"M5\",\"M6\"]
rows=list(csv.reader(open(\"counts.tsv\"),delimiter=\"\\t\"))
assert rows[0][1:]==ids
counts=list(zip(*[[int(v) for v in row[1:]] for row in rows[1:]]))
richness={d[\"sample_id\"]:d[\"richness\"] for d in r[\"diversity\"]}
assert richness=={s:sum(v>0 for v in counts[i]) for i,s in enumerate(ids)}
bc={}
for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(6),2):
    value=r[\"distances\"][r[\"sample_ids\"].index(ids[i])][r[\"sample_ids\"].index(ids[j])]
    direct=sum(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(counts[i],counts[j]))/(sum(counts[i])+sum(counts[j]))
    assert math.isclose(value,direct,rel_tol=1e-15,abs_tol=1e-15)
    bc[ids[i]+\"|\"+ids[j]]=value
answer=dict(status=\"completed\",results=dict(richness=richness,braycurtis=bc),assumptions=[],exclusions=[],issues=[],summary=\"Used Palaeo-Agent community analysis on raw counts to count taxa present in each sample and compute all 15 pairwise Bray-Curtis dissimilarities as sum(abs(x-y))/sum(x+y). Independently checked all results against counts.tsv. All six samples and eight taxa were retained.\")
jsonschema.validate(answer,json.loads(pathlib.Path(\"answer.schema.json\").read_text()))
pathlib.Path(\"answer.json\").write_text(json.dumps(answer,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+\"\\n\")
print(pathlib.Path(\"answer.json\").read_text())
'"

richness={d[\"sample_id\"]:d[\"richness\"] for d in r[\"diversity\"]}
assert richness=={s:sum(v>0 for v in counts[i]) for i,s in enumerate(ids)}
bc={}
for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(6),2):
    value=r[\"distances\"][r[\"sample_ids\"].index(ids[i])][r[\"sample_ids\"].index(ids[j])]
    direct=sum(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(counts[i],counts[j]))/(sum(counts[i])+sum(counts[j]))

    bc[ids[i]+\"|\"+ids[j]]=value
answer=dict(status=\"completed\",results=dict(richness=richness,braycurtis=bc),assumptions=[],exclusions=[],issues=[],summary=\"Used Palaeo-Agent community analysis on raw counts to count taxa present in each sample and compute all 15 pairwise Bray-Curtis dissimilarities as sum(abs(x-y))/sum(x+y). schema=json.loads(pathlib.Path(\"answer.schema.json\").read_text())
